verdict.rationale: Feitian documents NFC as an interface on its keys and says it can be used to complete FIDO U2F registration and authentication. It also explicitly markets a USB + NFC key for login on Android, which covers the core of tapping the key on a phone. Missing for 10: explicit NFC support on iOS phones, documentation specific to mobile browsers versus native apps, NFC setup guides, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can tap the key on my phone over NFC to authenticate in mobile browsers and apps

citations.quote: USB, NFC, and BLE, MultiPass FIDO® Security Key employs three communication interfaces. Users can use any of these interfaces to complete FIDO® U2F registration and authentication.
USB + NFC security key for login on PC and Android
